  Readable gloss: "Primarily the name of the notorious queen mother who seized Judah's throne after her son Ahaziah was killed by Jehu. A daughter (or granddaughter) of Omri and Ahab, she brought Baal worship into the southern kingdom and attempted to exterminate the Davidic line — only the infant Joash survived, hidden in the temple for six years (2 Kings 11:1-3). Her dramatic overthrow by the priest Jehoiada (2 Kings 11:13-20) restored both the Davidic monarchy and Yahwistic worship. The name also appears for a Benjaminite (1 Chronicles 8:26) and two post-exilic figures (Ezra 8:7; 10:28). The Greek rendering Gotholia preserves the name across the Septuagint tradition."

She is the only woman to rule Judah, and 2 Chronicles 24:7 calls her 'that wicked woman.' The name also designates a Benjaminite...
